data.narrative:
Trilobio is a Seed-stage biotech company founded by Roya Amini-Naieni and Maximilian Schommer that has raised $11M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in Biotech & Health, including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

The applicable valuation method is Stage-Progression, which applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next-stage funding. Using the $11M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying the 2.5x progression multiple yields an implied valuation of $28M. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (median 5.5x across the three public names) was not executable due to absence of revenue disclosure—standard for private companies. Peer-median analysis was also inapplicable; while 8 same-sector peers exist, none met the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier required to establish a credible narrow peer set.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $32M, centered at $28M. This single-method triangulation carries material uncertainty given reliance on a generic stage-progression multiplier rather than company-specific revenue or market metrics. Key uncertainties include validation of the 2.5x multiplier for Trilobio's specific subsector within biotech, actual revenue trajectory post-Seed, and competitive positioning relative to the identified private peer set.
